user.title: Add your MT-VIKI HDMI matrix
user.description: Choose how to add your matrix.

manual.title: Connect to your MT-VIKI HDMI matrix
manual.description: Set up a MT-VIKI HDMI matrix switcher over TCP (tested with the MT-HD0808).

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the matrix.
data_description.port: TCP control port of the matrix (default 8080).
data_description.matrix_size: Number of inputs and outputs of your model.

scan.title: Scan the local network
scan.description: Probes every host in the given network for a matrix listening on TCP port 8080. This is opt-in and only scans the subnet you specify — no passive discovery is performed.

data_description.network: The subnet to scan, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Pre-filled with a best-effort guess of your local /24.

pick.title: Choose a device
pick.description: Select one of the matrices found by the scan, and confirm its matrix size.

data_description.device: host:port, the model reported by the device (if any), and its size where known.
data_description.matrix_size: Number of inputs and outputs of your model. Pre-filled from the scan when it could be determined.

error.invalid_network: Not a valid network in CIDR notation
error.network_too_large: Network is too large to scan (maximum 1024 hosts)
error.no_devices_found: No MT-VIKI matrices found on that network

data_description.enable_polling: Periodically query routing, key lock, and beep state in addition to push updates.

input_names.title: Name your inputs
input_names.description: Give each input a friendly name. These names appear on the output selects, media players, and the routing services. Leave a field as-is to keep the default "Input N".

scene_names.title: Name your scenes
scene_names.description: Give each of the device's 16 scene slots a friendly name. These names appear on the scene recall buttons and the current-scene sensor. Leave a field as-is to keep the default "Scene N".

set_route.name: Set route
set_route.description: Routes an input to one or more outputs.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to control (alternative to selecting a device).

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.description: List of output port numbers, or the string 'all' to route the input to every output.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Saves the current routing as a scene on the matrix.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to control (alternative to selecting a device).

recall_scene.name: Recall scene
recall_scene.description: Recalls a stored routing scene on the matrix.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to control (alternative to selecting a device).

set_output_hdcp.name: Set output HDCP
set_output_hdcp.description: Sets the HDCP mode of an output. Mode value semantics are unverified on hardware; the adopted mapping is 0 = off, 1 = HDCP 1.4, 2 = HDCP 2.0, 3 = HDCP 2.2.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to control (alternative to selecting a device).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: HDCP mode: 0 = off, 1 = HDCP 1.4, 2 = HDCP 2.0, 3 = HDCP 2.2.

set_input_edid.name: Set input EDID
set_input_edid.description: Assigns an EDID preset to an input. Valid preset values are not documented by the vendor; 1-16 are accepted.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to control (alternative to selecting a device).

locate.name: Locate
locate.description: Beeps the matrix repeatedly so it can be found in the rack.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the matrix to locate (alternative to selecting a device).
